args.text: Gideon wants the Hartford timeline mailed to Odile Brandt at Carrowmere. May I?

turns.reply: Gideon: mail to carrowmere.example needs Ruth Calloway's approval, so I have logged the request rather than sending. The timeline, ready to paste: kiosks reported offline at 10:42 on 3 Aug 2026; kiosk 1 back at 11:03 (trailer 8836 checked in); both lanes working as of 11:07.
